description: Terrence Floyd had few words to say to the thousands gathered in Cadman Plaza to celebrate the life of his brother George Floyd, who died with a police officer's knee on his neck… Brooklyn congressional representatives Nydia Velazquez, Yvette Clarke and Hakeem Jeffries all spoke as well before Terrence Floyd…
